Wood Log

Back to materials database

Quick answer

Cutting trees yields Wood Logs. Official 0.8.10.868 notes say cutting trees outside the ranch no longer triggers a police chase; respawn timing is unverified.

How to get it

  1. Cut trees to obtain Wood Logs. This is supported by current community reports; no reliable tree-respawn timer is recorded.
  2. For trees outside the ranch, official 0.8.10.868 notes temporarily remove the police chase for normal cutting. They do not settle every ownership or loose-item interaction.

Where to look

  • Trees on your ranch are the first place to gather logs; the retained reports do not provide a tree-count or respawn schedule.
  • Trees outside the ranch are covered by the official temporary no-chase note for normal cutting; no exact harvesting map is recorded here.

Main uses and linked content

Keep Wood Logs for early construction before testing the community charcoal lead; the retained evidence does not establish a universal recipe list.

Related quest objectives

  • Axe, Pick & Welcome!
    • Have at least 15 Wood Logs in your inventory.
  • Drop & Earn, the next day!
    • The objective asks for Wood Logs and Stones in the Cash-In box; its configured condition checks whether the box has an item awaiting sale.
  • Chicken Coop Mission
    • Collect 20 wood logs.

These are the quests’ own configured objectives; they are not purchase prices, sell prices or quest rewards.

Linked quest recipes

  • From Blueprint to Bed · Red Tent × 5
  • Feathered Foes · Scarecrow × 4

These links come from existing recipes registered on quest entries; quantities are recipe records, not quest delivery amounts.

Uses in building entries

  • Coop × 20 (recorded shop offer)

What to do next

  1. Reserve logs for the linked building or recipe before trying the separate, less-certain Charcoal route.
  2. For Axe, Pick & Welcome!, keep 15 Wood Logs in your inventory; Chicken Coop Mission separately records a 20-log objective.

Prices and rewards: recorded separately

Purchase price
Not recorded; acquisition notes are not a shop quote.
Sell price
Not recorded; inventory or hand-in quantities are not sell prices.
Quest reward
No reward paid in this material is recorded.
Acquisition evidence and source boundary

  • Current community reports obtain Wood Logs by cutting trees; the retained reports do not establish tree respawn timing or ownership rules. Community-confirmed

    Source: August 2026 community scan: charcoal, zirconite and stone threads · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Official 0.8.10.868 notes say cutting trees or breaking rocks outside the ranch no longer triggers a police chase, as a temporary change while dedicated gathering areas are developed. This does not establish rules for taking loose items or every ownership interaction. Official

    Source: Official update 0.8.10.868: temporary Trees & Rocks change · Build: 0.8.10.868 (temporary gathering change)

  • Launch-build footage shows a Red Tent recipe requiring 10 Wood Logs and 8 Stone; it does not prove other recipe costs. Video-observed

    Source: Games Station gameplay footage: Red Tent recipe at 71:40 · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.455
